narration: [chintu] <bookmark mark='m1'/>There are ten floors, so the building is ten metres tall.
<bookmark mark='m2'/>Ten metres would be only ten Somus standing on top of one another.
<bookmark mark='m3'/>But each floor is already four Somus tall, so that stack is far too short.

narration: <bookmark mark='m1'/>The height of a building is the number of floors times the height of one floor.
<bookmark mark='m2'/>To see how much taller, we subtract, and to count the floors we divide.
<bookmark mark='m3'/>Your turn. A tower has twelve floors of three metres each. How tall is it?
